name: CJ Cheiljedang Corporation
summary: CJ Cheiljedang Corporation engages in the food business in South Korea and internationally. It operates through Food, Biotechnology, Feed and Care, and Logistics segments. The company offers home meal replacement, meat/fishery processing, seasoning/sauce, sweetener/flour/oil, and seaweed/dessert/snack/beverage products. It also provides amino acid, green protein, enzyme, plant nutrition and health, and specialty solution; biopolymer solution; and polyhydroxyalkanoate products. In addition, the company offers taste and nutrition solutions.
